summary_1line: After Anshuman and Dilipa fail to bring Ganga to earth, Bhagiratha performs severe austerities and wins Brahma’s boon to liberate Sagara’s sons.

image_candidates.scene_text: Bhagiratha stands with arms raised amid five blazing fires under the scorching sun, performing severe penance for a thousand years.
Brahma descends from the heavens surrounded by devas to address the emaciated yet radiant Bhagiratha in meditation.
Prince Anshuman listens solemnly as Garuda explains that only the sacred Ganga’s waters can redeem the ashes of Sagara’s sixty thousand sons.
